default_body.markdown:
**Highlights:**
- Updated prismaAGSL (Liquid Glass component) from 1.0.6 to 1.0.7
- Added a music widget
- Slightly improved Liquid Glass performance
- Potential improvement to MC loading times
- Added notifications for launcher updates
- The 3 navigation buttons are now centered and expand from the right
- Overhauled the launch panel

**Other changes:**
- Fix: "Game version" filter caused errors when Liquid Glass was enabled
- Fix: Page information text would incorrectly adopt the Liquid Glass style when returning to the home screen
- Fix: Cursor customization caused the launcher to crash
- Fix: Pages like "Downloads - Games" were positioned slightly higher than the adjacent game buttons
- The launch panel can now be placed anywhere
- Drastically reduced log file size
- Slightly reduced the overall launcher size
- Removed SPEFW
- Removed various rarely used features
- home screen now has a cleaner, edge-to-edge design
- `latest_game.log` has been merged into `latest.log`
- Expanded the Liquid Glass effect
- App/instance icons now appear rounded
